# Image dedup service

*Client industry: media | Completed: 2023-04-25 | Evidence id: ai_ml:case:p16*

## The problem
The client was a stock-photo site with near-duplicate uploads.

## What I did
I scoped the work with the client, then built the solution using Python scripts, a deep learning framework with custom training loops, an in-process similarity index, a typed async Python web API. I kept the client in the loop with short weekly demos and wrote handover notes.

## Result
The project removed 120k near-duplicates from the catalogue.
